model_annotation:
The line graph shows the F1 scores of three models, lattice, FLAT, and OURS, across different epochs. The x-axis represents epochs, marked in intervals of 2 from 0 to 18. The y-axis represents F1 scores, marked from 0.55 to 0.90 in intervals of 0.05. 

The red line with square markers represents the lattice model; it starts approximately at (2, 0.60) and increases to approximately (16, 0.85). The blue line with circular markers represents the FLAT model; it starts approximately at (2, 0.80) and increases to approximately (16, 0.87). The yellow line with triangular markers represents the OURS model; it starts approximately at (2, 0.80) and increases to approximately (16, 0.90).
